newsitem.title: TURKEY: Seven die in Northern Iraq suicide raid, Kurdish TV.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in Northern Iraq suicide raid, Kurdish TV.

text.p: A suicide attack by a guerrilla of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) against a rival Kurdish group killed seven people in the northern Iraqi city of Arbil, the pro-Kurdish MED-TV channel said on Wednesday.
The report came as Turkey's air and ground assault against PKK positions in the mountainous regions of northern Iraq entered its fourth week.

In Arbil, fighters of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) -- currently allied with Ankara against the PKK -- raided on Monday a house sheltering two PKK members, one man and one woman, a spokesman for the Belgian-based channel told Reuters.
The man was killed immediately. The woman held out until her ammunition ran out, then charged the KDP forces carrying hand grenades, which exploded killing her and six KDP members.
MED-TV also reported that KDP leader Massoud Barzani had made a peace offer to the PKK via KDP radio on Monday night.
"The PKK is a very strong political and military force...we are ready for any kind of peace with the PKK," MED-TV quoted him as saying in the radio address.
There was no independent confirmation of the peace offer.
